## W. E. B. Du Bois and the 1900 Paris Exposition

-   The 1900 Paris Expo celebrated the achievements of the prior century
-   Thomas Calloway[^1] lobbied to become a Special Agent for the US delegation, spearheading an exhibit focused on African Americans
-   W. E. B. Du Bois[^2] organized and executed the exhibit which included more than 60 charts and statistical tables presenting demographic and economic data about African Americans. The exhibit also included several hundred photographs, scale models, and written works by African Americans.

[^1]: Calloway was an attorney and Howard Law School graduate

[^2]: Du Bois was a professor of History and Economics at Atlanta University which is now part of the Atlanta University Center along with Spelman

Part of this week's homework will be based on these charts.
